description: This file is a shell script used for merging Git trees, resolving conflicts, and managing merge bases and heads during a Git merge process. It includes logic for handling multiple remotes, performing a simplified merge attempt, and falling back to an automatic merge if necessary.

methods.name: main logic of the script
methods.description: Initializes variables, performs merge checks, updates index, and attempts a merge using Git commands. Handles failures gracefully with appropriate exits.
